title: Comparing two robots, hosts or containers with AutoDiag
keywords: autodiag this tool compare comparison two robots robot hosts host machines laptop containers config configuration difference differences snapshot collect transfer salt redact peer
text: To compare two robots (or a robot and a laptop, or two containers), save a snapshot on each and compare the files: run dds-autodiag collect --redact --salt team42 -o robot1.json on the first robot and the same with -o robot2.json on the second (same salt on both), copy the files to one machine and run dds-autodiag compare robot1.json robot2.json --report report.md. The dashboard Hosts tab does the same: the process you opened is this host; load a snapshot, paste JSON or connect to a token-protected live collector (URL plus AUTODIAG_AGENT_TOKEN) as the peer. The Docker table runs docker on this process only and cannot list the laptop. It compares the domain ID, RMW (Zenoh vs DDS is an error), ROS distro, discovery range, network interfaces and IPC namespace, and turns differences into findings. AutoDiag never copies configuration: use the comparison to see what differs, change the settings yourself, then compare again to confirm.
